headline: Iran Conflict Triples Logistics Costs for Middle East Oil Services Firms
summary: Oilfield services companies in the Middle East face up to threefold logistics costs, doubled fuel expenses, and 40% higher labor costs due to ongoing delivery and operational disruptions.
why: Oilfield services companies provide essential drilling, equipment, and operational support to energy producers. Cost inflation in this sector can squeeze profit margins and impact global oil exploration efficiency.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Increased logistics, fuel, and labor costs create direct margin pressure for oilfield services firms operating in the region.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rising operational and logistics expenses driven by the conflict increase the cost structure for energy service providers, negatively impacting sector profitability.
